Overview & City Profile

Puerto de la Cruz (Puerto de la Cruz (Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife)) is a municipality in Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands (coordinates 28.4105°N, -16.5462°E; population 32,665). Visitors use Puerto de la Cruz as a base to explore Canary Islands's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Papas arrugadas con mojo picón y verde, Gofio escaldado, Queso Majorero & Almogrote.

Within Canary Islands Region (Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife region), Puerto de la Cruz (Puerto de la Cruz (Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife)) serves as a municipio (municipality) in canary islands region. Travelers exploring Canary Islands often combine a stop in Puerto de la Cruz with regional highlights such as Mount Teide National Park (Tenerife), Timanfaya Volcanic National Park (Lanzarote), Maspalomas Dunes & Roque Nublo (Gran Canaria), La Gomera Garajonay laurel forest.

Getting to Puerto de la Cruz & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)): Direct flights to Tenerife (TFS/TFN), Gran Canaria (LPA), Lanzarote (ACE) and Fuerteventura (FUE); Fred. Olsen & Armas inter-island ferries.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Canary Islands Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas with Puerto de la Cruz. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep €1,000 bills and €100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Canary Islands have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Puerto de la Cruz en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Puerto de la Cruz are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail station or airport in Canary Islands can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Spain Guide.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Canary Islands: Year-round (eternal spring 20–26°C).

Regional highlights across Canary Islands Region that pair well with a visit to Puerto de la Cruz include: Mount Teide National Park (Tenerife), Timanfaya Volcanic National Park (Lanzarote), Maspalomas Dunes & Roque Nublo (Gran Canaria), La Gomera Garajonay laurel forest.

Practical Travel Tips for Puerto de la Cruz

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Puerto de la Cruz (or at Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Puerto de la Cruz accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Spain Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Puerto de la Cruz (Puerto de la Cruz (Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife)) located in Spain?

Puerto de la Cruz (Puerto de la Cruz (Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife)) is a municipio (municipality) located in Canary Islands Region in the Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife region of Spain (coordinates: 28.4105°N, -16.5462°E). It has a population of approximately 32,665 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Puerto de la Cruz by train?

Most visitors reach Puerto de la Cruz via the main prefectural gateway of Santa Cruz de Tenerife / Las Palmas Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail). Direct flights to Tenerife (TFS/TFN), Gran Canaria (LPA), Lanzarote (ACE) and Fuerteventura (FUE); Fred. Olsen & Armas inter-island ferries. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Puerto de la Cruz. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Puerto de la Cruz and Canary Islands known for?

In Puerto de la Cruz and across Canary Islands Region, top local dishes include Papas arrugadas con mojo picón y verde, Gofio escaldado, Queso Majorero & Almogrote, as well as Sancocho Canario and Malvasía volcanic wines of Lanzarote. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Puerto de la Cruz?

Best time to visit Canary Islands: Year-round (eternal spring 20–26°C). Check our Spain Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
